name: VV: Ultimatum [RELEASE!🎉]
desc:
VV: Ultimatum is a stylized fighting game in which you navigate dangerous worlds, protect and serve your chosen faction, and engage in thrilling combat with strange monsters and ancient threats. With over 130 skills and abilities to choose from, developing a character uniquely tailored to your play style has never been easier.

Fan of the game? Favorite ⭐ and Like 👍 so you can play again next time!

Support the Game by:
● 👍 Leaving a Like
● ⭐ Favoriting
● 📶 and Following the Game's Activity by joining the group

scripts.title: FrostX
scripts.features:
⚔️ Auto Parry
Auto Parry — weapon timings (pre-tuned, locked in)
Tuning — Hitbox Size, Detection Range, Timing Offset
Hitbox Learning — Auto-Learn Hitboxes + Learned Box Margin
Targeting — Target Filter (Both/Player/Mob), Auto Dodge
Humanizer — Miss Rate, Dash-Instead Rate, Timing Jitter
Aim Lock — FOV, Range, Smoothness, Sticky Target (keybind: K)
Show Hitboxes

🔊 Sound Parry
Sound Parry toggle, Detection Range, Show Hitboxes 

🎯 Projectiles
Projectile Parry toggle, Detection Range, Show Hitboxes 

👁️ Visuals
FPS / Ping HUD
ESP — Name, Health, 2D Box, Outline, Threat Color (attacker → red) + Threat Range
Advanced ESP — health bar, optimization, filters, name scale, distance, weapon, combat stats (Reiatsu, Posture, Stamina, Race/Form, States)
Graphics — Fullbright, No Fog/Blur/Shadows/Sea/Particles/Clothes/Explosions, Low-Quality Meshes, Custom FOV

🏃 Movement
Fly (+ speed), Noclip, Tween To Back (sticky attach, full tuning), Ignore Players

🎒 Items
Auto Sell (materials, dry-run preview, refresh)

🛡️ Safety
Moderator Checker, YouTuber Checker, Stream Proof, Notifications + Safety Alerts, Debug Panel

⌨️ Keybinds (HUD-shown)
Menu, All Parry (N), Target Filter (B), Aim Lock (K), Fly, Noclip, ESP, Tween-To-Back, Panic Hide

⚙️ Settings
Accent color, opacity, UI scale, FPS/Ping HUD, Keybind HUD, Show Roblox Chat, full Profiles system (save/load/import/export/backup), Performance Mode, Reset, Uninject
